name: presence is permission
headline: *Presence* is permission
say: Here is the part that surprises people. There is no account, and no sign-up. Hypercomb runs in your browser, or as an app on your desktop, and your work is kept on your own device. Nothing leaves it until you decide. When you do share, your work goes to a host: a home for it on the open web. That can be your own machine, your own domain, or the host of a friend you trust. Presence is permission. Your work is where you are, and it goes only where you send it.
